# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

- [Morocco gets its first woman prime minister](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/01-morocco-first-woman-pm.html) — King Mohammed VI named Marrakesh's mayor as the country's first female prime minister.
- [Trump tells the US government to stop saying "artificial intelligence](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/02-trump-superintelligence-order.html) — A new executive order rebrands AI as "Super Intelligence" across federal messaging.
- [The ice blasting off Enceladus is stranger than scientists realized](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/03-enceladus-ice-chemistry.html) — Freezing ocean droplets may sort chemicals on their own before they shoot into space.
- [The UK is paying more on 10-year debt than at any point since 1999](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/04-uk-mortgages-bond-auction.html) — As gilt yields hit a 26-year high, UK mortgage approvals sank to their lowest since late 2023.
- [A London stage turns economist John Maynard Keynes into flesh and blood](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/05-standard-of-living-keynes-play.html) — The Standard of Living," starring Rory Kinnear, weaves economic theory into the story of the Bloomsbury group.
- [Dutch police arrest suspected leader of hacking group ShinyHunters](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/06-shinyhunters-arrest.html) — The group has been linked to breaches at Ticketmaster, Rockstar Games and, most recently, the FBI.
- [Cape Town can't agree on what to do about its baboons](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/07-cape-town-baboons.html) — The city council wants to remove two troops of baboons, but animal-rights activists insist coexistence still works.
- [OpenAI pulled its own model over safety concerns](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/01-openai-astra-safety-pause.html) — The company admitted its newest model failed internal alignment checks.

- [Hungary strips immunity from its sitting prime minister](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/03-hungary-lifts-magyar-immunity.html) — Parliament cleared the way for criminal probes into Magyar and two Orban-era ministers.

- [Mathematicians crack a 55-year-old conjecture](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/05-juggling-conjecture-solved.html) — A group of young mathematicians resolved the puzzle, likely inspired by juggling, using randomness.
- [Mighty Sparrow, the King of Calypso, has died](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/06-mighty-sparrow-calypso-king-dies.html) — The singer and songwriter who shaped the genre for decades was 91.
- [Florida goes to court to halt OpenAI's frontier AI work, calling LLMs a "public nuisance](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/07-florida-sues-openai-frontier-ai.html) — The state wants a court to stop OpenAI's frontier development, arguing LLMs threaten civilization — on the same day OpenAI itself pulled a model release.
- [The universe measures out flat — that still doesn't mean it's infinite](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/08-is-the-universe-infinite.html) — CMB measurements show the cosmos is remarkably flat — but flat space can still be finite if it wraps back on itself.
- [UK's Healey vows to "reindustrialise Britain" — without saying how he'll pay for it](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/09-healey-reindustrialise-britain.html) — In his first conference speech as chancellor, John Healey promised fiscal discipline, welfare reform and a new apprenticeships scheme — a month before the budget.
- [Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh wins the Vaclav Havel prize](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-29/10-sotoudeh-havel-prize.html) — The Council of Europe honoured her for years defending the rights of women, children and political prisoners in Iran.
- [South Africa saw 27 killed in two separate mass shootings in one weekend](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-28/01-south-africa-mass-shootings.html) — Near Johannesburg it was a fight over illegal gold mining; near Cape Town, a shooting at a barbecue.
- [Vučić resigns as Serbia's president — but plans to run for prime minister](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-28/02-serbia-vucic-resignation.html) — Snap parliamentary elections are set for next month.
- [Poland is pouring money into defense. Will its economy thank it or pay for it?](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-28/03-poland-defense-boom-economy.html) — The Guardian opens a new series on Poland's economy with a village where missile launchers now roll instead of tractors.
